description: This file defines WebSocket broadcast hooks for handling mentions, followers, acknowledgments, permalinks, channel mentions, and burn-on-read features in Mattermost's server code. It includes hook registration, processing logic, permission checks, and utility functions.

classes.name: addMentionsBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing mention broadcasts, adding mention info if user is mentioned.

classes.name: addFollowersBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing follower broadcasts, adding follower info if user is a follower.

classes.name: postedAckBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing acknowledgment of posted messages, determining if acknowledgment should be sent.

classes.name: permalinkBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing permalink previews, adding permalink metadata if user has access.

classes.name: channelMentionsBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for filtering channel mentions based on user permissions.

classes.name: burnOnReadBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for handling burn-on-read post processing, removing sensitive data.

classes.name: burnOnReadReactionBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for handling burn-on-read reactions, checking read receipts.

methods.name: makeBroadcastHooks
methods.description: Returns a map of broadcast hook names to hook instances for registration.

methods.name: useAddMentionsHook
methods.description: Adds a mention hook to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: useAddFollowersHook
methods.description: Adds a followers hook to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: usePostedAckHook
methods.description: Adds a posted acknowledgment hook to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: usePermalinkHook
methods.description: Adds a permalink metadata hook to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: useBurnOnReadHook
methods.description: Adds a burn-on-read hook to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: useBurnOnReadReactionHook
methods.description: Adds a burn-on-read reaction hook to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: getPostFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts and unmarshals the current post from a WebSocket message.

methods.name: getTypedArg
methods.description: Retrieves and correctly types a hook argument, re-encoding/decoding JSON if necessary.

methods.name: incrementWebsocketCounter
methods.description: Increments notification metrics counter if enabled.
